description: This file contains the implementation of the EscaperNodeVisitor class within the Twig templating engine. It handles node traversal for auto-escaping mechanisms, managing safe variables, escaping conditions, and applying escape filters during template parsing.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\EscaperNodeVisitor
classes.description: This class visits nodes in a Twig template AST to insert escaping logic where necessary, supporting autoescaping strategies and safe variable analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EscaperNodeVisitor, setting up safe analysis and other internal states.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic when entering a node during traversal, updating escape status and safe variables.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles cleanup and escape logic when leaving a node, applying filters and escaping expressions as needed.

methods.name: escapeConditional
methods.description: Recursively escapes operands within conditional expressions based on the specified escape type.

methods.name: escapeExpression
methods.description: Determines if an expression is safe for a given escape type and applies escaping if necessary.

methods.name: preEscapeFilterNode
methods.description: Prepares a FilterExpression node for escaping based on its defined pre-escape type.

methods.name: isSafeFor
methods.description: Checks if an expression is considered safe for a certain escape type, utilizing safe analysis.

methods.name: needEscaping
methods.description: Returns the current escape status or default strategy if none is set.

methods.name: getEscaperFilter
methods.description: Creates an escape filter node for a given expression and escape type.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor.
